metadata.title: COLORED JONES POLYNOMIALS WITHOUT TAILS
metadata.authors_raw: CHRISTINE RUEY SHAN LEE AND ROLAND VAN DER VEEN
metadata.abstract: We exhibit an inﬁnite family of knots with the property that the ﬁrst coeﬃcient of the n-colored Jones polynomial grows linearly with n. This shows that the concept of stability and tail seen in the colored Jones polynomials of alternating knots does not generalize naively.
